Campus Visiting Regulations

To preserve instructional focus and dormitory safety, unannounced personal visits are not permitted during school weekdays. Prospective parents must report directly to the security gatehouse for visitor passes.

Admissions Office Hours:Mon–Fri: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Saturday Secretariat:8:30 AM – 1:00 PM
Parent Visitation Day:First Sunday of Each Term

Transit Directions to Campus

From Kampala & Entebbe International Airport

Take the Kampala–Gulu Highway (A109) via Karuma Bridge (approx. 330km, 4.5 hours driving time). Upon arrival at Gulu Main Roundabout, branch onto Acholi Road heading northwest for 2.2 kilometres.

From Lira, Kitgum & Pader Municipalities

Access Gulu City via the Kitgum–Gulu or Lira–Gulu highway. Taxis and public coaches terminate at the Gulu Bus Terminal, where authorized school shuttles operate during opening and visitation days.

By Charter Aircraft (Gulu Airstrip)

Gulu Airport receives domestic scheduled flights and humanitarian aviation charters. The campus is located 12 minutes drive from the terminal.

Campus Reception

Plan an In-Person Campus Visitation

We encourage prospective families to tour our science laboratories, student hostels, sports grounds, and classrooms along Acholi Road in Gulu City.
